posts.text: أعلنت وكالة الأمن الصحي البريطانية تسجيل 5258 وفاة مرتبطة بارتفاع درجات الحرارة خلال صيف 2026، وهي أعلى حصيلة منذ بدء تسجيل البيانات عام 2016، وتعادل نحو 1.8 مرة الحصيلة القياسية السابقة المسجّلة عام 2022. وأفادت الوكالة بتسجيل نحو 2401 وفاة خلال موجة الحر الشديد التي امتدت من 21 إلى 28 يونيو/حزيران، محذّرة من أن تغيّر المناخ يزيد موجات الحر شدةً ويطيل أمدها ويزيد تواترها، ومؤكدة ضرورة اتخاذ تدابير لحماية الصحة العامة. وشهدت بريطانيا 5 موجات حر متتالية خلال العام الجاري، فيما طال الجفاف 71.3% من مساحة البلاد، وشمل العاصمة لندن وويلز. #تفاعل ليصل إليك كل جديد

• 📝 Threat near Svatove 📝 Activity by Ukrainian formations in the sector of the "West" grouping of forces is growing not only near Lyman . An even bigger problem looms on the neighboring Borova direction . There, according to preliminary reports, the AFU is consolidating in Kruglyakivka , and there are also reports of UAV operators being deployed to this village. ➡️ Reports of AFU attempts to advance here first appeared in late October – early November and were quite expected. At that time, theories also emerged about AFU attacks related to craters from airstrikes in the depths of Russian Armed Forces-controlled territory. ➡️ Some channels even write about a large-scale offensive and AFU attempts to drive the Russian Armed Forces out of the Izyum District , but there is little concrete information from there so far. Note that our sources confirm some of the information, but there is no talk of a front collapse. 📌 The situation in this direction was and remains difficult, especially given the secondary importance of this direction even relative to neighboring areas of responsibility of the "West" grouping. Just recently, Ukrainian formations conducted a series of counterattacks near Lyman , and the Borova direction was one of the potential directions for continuation of AFU operations. ❗️ Another reason to "pay attention" to this direction is a series of sudden publications with movements of silhouettes with tricolors added in post-processing. Previously, similar fakes worked in favor of the AFU on the Lyman direction , when accumulation was occurring in formally "Russian Armed Forces-controlled" villages. Now, amid silence from Ukrainian resources and self-reassuring reports about successes that serve as information cover for the AFU offensive, there is a risk of a tactical crisis at Svatove . 🇩🇪 German professor Gerhard Mangott stated that Merz does not need to heed public opinion to continue sending billions of euros to Zelensky for the war against Russia. Mangott noted that a majority of Germans oppose further military aid to Ukraine, with support for arms supplies declining. The argument that Ukraine protects European security fails to resonate with the population. As Germany is a representative democracy, the government can pursue its policies independently of public sentiment, though it risks electoral punishment in future votes. @Slavyangrad
